explanation: All seven games are now published on itch.io, including Cat Bond. Cat Bond appeared publicly on itch.io's Cats, Cozy+Pets and simulation browse lists as of November 20, 2026; other six were verified on logged-in studio page Nov 19. CrazyGames Pawsibly Innocent quality rejection is owner-reported; portal record has not been rechecked.

submissionPolicy.source: Morrow Wish conservative quality-first policy (not a claimed CrazyGames platform limit)
submissionPolicy.afterSubmit: Review only one QA-approved game at a time; no automatic submissions or retries, especially after quality rejection.
submissionPolicy.onNewPublicGame: Queue for both platforms after Cloudflare deployment succeeds; do not mistake a queue issue for a platform submission.

crazygames.notes: Owner-reported rejection for overall game quality; not independently revalidated in CrazyGames developer portal. Do not resubmit without substantive redesign plus explicit QA gate.
Validate mobile landscape panning/fullscreen and gameplay before review submission
Validate first-30-second onboarding and touch layout
Validate small-screen text readability and meaningful choices
Validate click/tap sorting and restart UX
Validate touch controls, replay and difficulty ramp
Validate feeding mechanic, distinct endings and retry flow
